notes: Printed names: 'CARTHAGE PIKE', 'BEAR ... AV.', 'MARMET AV.', 'W. ERKENBRECHER AV.', 'VINE', 'W. SHIELDS'. The north half is mostly 'See Volume Six'. Marmet Av is only a stub north of Bear (no width printed, ~28 ft between kerbs). Bear runs E from the Pike then angles NE and ends on the SW side of Erkenbrecher (T; centre computed from the kerb lines, the 6-inch main in Erkenbrecher runs ~110 px SW of the centreline so it was not used). Erkenbrecher continues NW off the sheet (Volume Six) and E past Vine (Volume Five); Vine starts at Erkenbrecher (north kerb of Erkenbrecher continuous), so that is a T. Shields: Vine crossing opens east into 'See Volume Five'. Alleys: two 20 ft paper alleys run N-S inside block between a lot line at y~3900 and y~5340 (neither reaches a street); a narrow (~11 ft, no width printed) passage runs from y~5340 south to Shields at x~3787 - not aligned with Moffett (which ends at Shields from the south at x~3262 on this sheet's coordinates). Carthage/Shields and Vine/Shields are also on 270; Carthage/Bear is also on 269 (6130,905).
